sections.heading: 1. Purpose and Scope
sections.body: This AI Evidence Retention Policy establishes the requirements for the preservation of evidence related to AI system operations within {system_name} operated by {org_name}. This policy applies to all data and logs within the system boundary defined as {boundary}, specifically protecting AI-generated outputs and training data containing {cui_description}.

sections.heading: 2. AI Evidence Retention Requirements

questions.prompt: What specific types of AI evidence (e.g., prompt logs, model versions, weights, audit trails) are kept?
What is the defined retention period for this AI evidence?
How is AI evidence securely disposed of after the retention period expires?

sections.body: To ensure accountability and auditability, {org_name} maintains the following AI evidence: {evidence_types_defined}. All identified evidence shall be retained for a period of {retention_period}. Upon expiration of the retention period, evidence will be handled via {disposal_method}.
